question: All of the following side effects are produced by Cisplatin except
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Cisplatin" -> "known to cause ototoxicity" -> "associated with hearing loss" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Cisplatin" -> "known to cause nephrotoxicity" -> "can lead to renal impairment" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Cisplatin" -> "not associated with coasting effect" -> "coasting effect is related to other drugs" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Cisplatin" -> "not typically linked to pulmonary fibrosis" -> "pulmonary fibrosis is more common with other agents" -> 80%
analysis: Cisplatin is a well-known chemotherapeutic agent that is associated with several side effects. Among the options provided, ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity are well-documented side effects of Cisplatin. The coasting effect, which refers to a delayed onset of toxicity after the cessation of a drug, is not a characteristic of Cisplatin but is more commonly associated with other agents. Pulmonary fibrosis is also not typically linked to Cisplatin; it is more associated with drugs like bleomycin. Therefore, the most accurate answer is that Cisplatin does not produce the coasting effect, making it the exception among the listed side effects.
